name: natural-resource commons
sourceGroundedScope: Shared, exhaustible natural resources provide the historical and analytic roots for knowledge-commons work.
representativeEntries: forests | fisheries | groundwater | atmosphere | oceans

name: common-pool resource
sourceGroundedScope: A subtractable resource from which excluding potential beneficiaries is costly.

name: public good
sourceGroundedScope: A generally nonrival and difficult-to-exclude good; knowledge often has these attributes.

name: club or toll good
sourceGroundedScope: A relatively nonrival resource from which access can be excluded, including subscription systems.

name: private good
sourceGroundedScope: A rival and excludable resource used as a contrast to commons provision.

name: global commons
sourceGroundedScope: Resources and knowledge systems whose use and governance extend across political boundaries.

name: new commons
sourceGroundedScope: Recently recognized shared resources, especially cultural, neighborhood, infrastructure, and knowledge resources.

name: knowledge commons
sourceGroundedScope: A shared knowledge resource governed as a complex social-ecological system of artifacts, facilities, communities, and rules.

name: information commons
sourceGroundedScope: Shared information resources or integrated campus environments combining information, technology, and assistance.
representativeEntries: University of Arizona information commons | Indiana University Information Commons | info-commons.org

name: digital commons
sourceGroundedScope: Digitally networked shared resources whose openness depends on technical and institutional design.

name: Internet or communication commons
sourceGroundedScope: Shared communications infrastructure and participatory network space enabling decentralized exchange.

name: intellectual commons
sourceGroundedScope: A domain for creating and circulating ideas through open access, custom, law, and institutional arrangements.

name: scholarly-communication commons
sourceGroundedScope: Shared publication processes, repositories, services, and communities supporting scholarship.
representativeEntries: Workshop on Scholarly Communication as a Commons

name: science commons or open science
sourceGroundedScope: Shared scientific code, models, data, literature, and collaborative infrastructure.
representativeEntries: Science Commons | UrbanSim | Open Source/Content Landcover Change Modeling Effort

name: cultural commons and public domain
sourceGroundedScope: Publicly reusable cultural materials and memory resources outside or deliberately opened beyond exclusive control.
representativeEntries: Project Gutenberg | Library of Congress | Open Content Alliance

name: associational commons
sourceGroundedScope: Knowledge created through voluntary associations and civic participation.
representativeEntries: Prince George's Information Commons

name: libertarian commons
sourceGroundedScope: Decentralized knowledge production without a single institutional manager.

name: commons-based peer production
sourceGroundedScope: Distributed voluntary production coordinated through open networks.
representativeEntries: Wikipedia | GNU/Linux

name: participatory media commons
sourceGroundedScope: Network platforms where users create, tag, share, and discover media.
representativeEntries: Flickr | Ourmedia.org | Publicnews.com | YouTube.com

name: civic or local information commons
sourceGroundedScope: Locally grounded public knowledge built jointly by residents, students, universities, and civic organizations.
representativeEntries: Prince George's Information Commons | San Diego Dialogue

name: open-access commons
sourceGroundedScope: Royalty-free scholarly literature made available online with broad reading and reuse permissions.
representativeEntries: Budapest Open Access Initiative | Public Library of Science | BioMed Central

name: free, libre, and open-source software commons
sourceGroundedScope: Source code governed through open licenses, community contribution, and project rules.
representativeEntries: GNU/Linux | Apache Web Server | Mozilla | OpenOffice

name: disciplinary knowledge commons
sourceGroundedScope: Shared literature, tools, dialogue, and services organized around a field or research community.
representativeEntries: Conservation Commons | RePEc | H-Net

name: research library
sourceGroundedScope: A library that collects, preserves, licenses, interprets, and increasingly produces scholarly resources.
representativeEntries: Workshop Research Library | Library of Congress

name: public lending library
sourceGroundedScope: The book's baseline access institution, governed by first sale, preservation, and public-service norms.

name: diffuse library
sourceGroundedScope: A library whose content, expertise, and access functions are distributed beyond one building or collection.

name: digital library
sourceGroundedScope: A managed digital collection joined to discovery, access, preservation, and user services.
representativeEntries: Digital Library of the Commons | National Science Digital Library | EconPort

name: collaborative or federated digital library
sourceGroundedScope: Multiple institutions coordinate collections, protocols, and governance to provide a shared service.
representativeEntries: Open Content Alliance | Distributed Open Digital Library | Aquifer Project

name: digital collection
sourceGroundedScope: A coherent set of digitized or born-digital objects presented as a reusable corpus.
representativeEntries: Library of Congress Edison film collection | ARTstor | The Valley of the Shadow

name: national library and catalog
sourceGroundedScope: National-scale holdings, catalogs, and preservation coordination.
representativeEntries: Library of Congress | Library of Congress catalog

name: institutional repository
sourceGroundedScope: An institutionally managed archive for faculty and organizational scholarship.
representativeEntries: DSpace | Érudit | eScholarship | DISPUTE

name: disciplinary repository
sourceGroundedScope: A repository shared by a discipline rather than one institution.
representativeEntries: arXiv | EconWPA | PhilSci Archive | RePEc

name: epistemic repository
sourceGroundedScope: A repository whose resource units are claims, artifacts, and community validation processes.

name: personal or self-archive
sourceGroundedScope: An author's own website or deposit route for openly circulating scholarship.

name: organizational archive
sourceGroundedScope: An archive operated by the organization that creates or controls the content; preservation Model A or B.

name: producer archive
sourceGroundedScope: An archive run by content producers or their institutions; preservation Model C.
representativeEntries: DSpace

name: consumer archive
sourceGroundedScope: An archive maintained by consumers or subscribing libraries; preservation Model D.

name: community-based or trusted third-party archive
sourceGroundedScope: A collectively trusted independent preservation service; preservation Model E.
representativeEntries: Portico | LOCKSS

name: dark or restricted preservation archive
sourceGroundedScope: An archive that preserves content but releases it only under specified trigger conditions.

name: specialist archive
sourceGroundedScope: A narrowly focused collection assembled by a specialist or community rather than a universal institution.

name: web archive
sourceGroundedScope: A preservation collection capturing portions of the changing web.
representativeEntries: Internet Archive

name: repository network or federation
sourceGroundedScope: Interoperable repositories whose metadata and holdings form a larger distributed corpus.
representativeEntries: Networked Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations | RePEc

name: campus information commons
sourceGroundedScope: A shared campus facility integrating library resources, computing, consultation, and media production.
representativeEntries: University of Arizona information commons | Indiana University Information Commons

name: campus learning commons
sourceGroundedScope: A learner-centered facility and program organized around shared learning tasks.
representativeEntries: IUPUI first-year learning commons

name: portal, directory, bibliography, or reference guide
sourceGroundedScope: A curated discovery structure pointing users to distributed resources, policies, or concepts.
representativeEntries: Comprehensive Bibliography of the Commons | DOAJ | Open Access Overview | EconPort searchable portal

name: open-access journal
sourceGroundedScope: A peer-reviewed journal whose articles are freely available online.
representativeEntries: PLoS Biology | Philosophers' Imprint | Nucleic Acids Research

name: open-access publisher or journal platform
sourceGroundedScope: An organization or platform that publishes and distributes OA journals.
representativeEntries: BioMed Central | Public Library of Science | SciELO | BioOne

name: dynamic or compound publication environment
sourceGroundedScope: A publication designed for continual revision or combining journal, alerts, dialogue, data, and analytic tools.
representativeEntries: Living Reviews | Signal Transduction Knowledge Environment

name: library publishing service
sourceGroundedScope: A library unit supplying publication technology, production, and stewardship.
representativeEntries: HighWire Press | Scholarly Publishing Office | Project Euclid

name: information community
sourceGroundedScope: An integrated digital setting joining a community's resources, tools, activities, and participants.
representativeEntries: University of Virginia American Studies information community

name: collaboratory
sourceGroundedScope: An online environment for remote instrument use, data analysis, communication, and research preservation.
representativeEntries: Space Physics and Aeronomy Research Collaboratory

name: virtual laboratory
sourceGroundedScope: A networked setting in which distributed participants configure, run, and analyze experiments.
representativeEntries: EconPort online experimental economics laboratory

name: data archive or research database
sourceGroundedScope: A maintained corpus of empirical data for analysis, teaching, or civic research.
representativeEntries: National Education Longitudinal Study | EconPort experiment-data archive

name: open educational resource
sourceGroundedScope: Course, book, handbook, experiment, or learning content made openly usable.
representativeEntries: MIT OpenCourseWare | Baen Free Library | EconPort Handbook

name: civic research and mapping project
sourceGroundedScope: Community-university work translating local data into public maps, indicators, deliberation, and action.
representativeEntries: San Diego Dialogue | Prince George's geography-and-obesity mapping project

name: distributed preservation system
sourceGroundedScope: Replicated, coordinated storage designed to keep digital materials available despite local failure.
representativeEntries: LOCKSS

name: trusted third-party preservation service
sourceGroundedScope: An independent organization preserving publishers' source files under agreed access triggers.
representativeEntries: Portico

name: national digital-preservation program
sourceGroundedScope: A national plan or program coordinating distributed custody, standards, and stewardship.
representativeEntries: National Digital Information and Infrastructure Preservation Program

name: metadata-harvesting and repository interoperability protocol
sourceGroundedScope: A low-barrier protocol enabling services to harvest metadata across distributed repositories.
representativeEntries: Open Archives Initiative

name: semantic interoperability layer
sourceGroundedScope: Shared metadata, vocabularies, and relationship structures that make heterogeneous collections work together.
representativeEntries: W3C Semantic Web | Aquifer Project

name: repository software
sourceGroundedScope: Open software for capturing, describing, exposing, and preserving repository content.
representativeEntries: DSpace | EPrints.org

name: content-management and journal-workflow software
sourceGroundedScope: Open software scaffolding contribution, editorial, and publication workflows.
representativeEntries: Open Journal Systems | Article System | efirst XML | Plone | Zope

name: version-control infrastructure
sourceGroundedScope: Tools that track contributions, branches, and versions in distributed collaborative production.
representativeEntries: Concurrent Versioning System

name: open-source project-hosting platform
sourceGroundedScope: Shared infrastructure for hosting source, versions, issue discussion, and developer coordination.
representativeEntries: SourceForge.net

name: open-content license
sourceGroundedScope: A standardized permission instrument allowing specified reuse of creative and knowledge works.
representativeEntries: Creative Commons | GNU Free Documentation License

name: copyleft or open-source software license
sourceGroundedScope: A license granting source access and reuse rights, sometimes requiring derivatives to remain open.
representativeEntries: GNU General Public License | Berkeley Software Distribution license

name: rights registry or clearance infrastructure
sourceGroundedScope: Administrative machinery for registering exclusive rights or reducing permission transaction costs.
representativeEntries: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office | Copyright Clearance Center

name: open-access declaration, mandate, or policy
sourceGroundedScope: A public statement, funder rule, institutional resolution, or law establishing expectations for open dissemination.
representativeEntries: Budapest Open Access Initiative | Berlin Declaration | NIH public-access policy

name: advocacy coalition, campaign, or toolkit
sourceGroundedScope: Coordinated organizations and practical resources that counter enclosure and change scholarly practice.
representativeEntries: SPARC | Information Access Alliance | Create Change | Scholarly Communication Toolkit

name: foundation, public trust, or funding program
sourceGroundedScope: Funding and institutional sponsorship that launches, experiments with, or sustains commons infrastructure.
representativeEntries: Andrew W. Mellon Foundation | Digital Opportunity Investment Trust | National Science Foundation

name: research-network infrastructure
sourceGroundedScope: High-capacity network services supporting distributed scholarship and collaboratories.
representativeEntries: Internet2

name: search, citation, and metadata-aggregation service
sourceGroundedScope: A service that indexes, links, ranks, or harvests distributed knowledge resources.
representativeEntries: OAIster | Google | Yahoo OA indexing | RePEc

name: mass-digitization initiative
sourceGroundedScope: A program converting large cultural collections into discoverable digital form.
representativeEntries: Google Print | Open Content Alliance | Digital Promise Project

name: trusted-repository standard or audit framework
sourceGroundedScope: Criteria and review structures used to establish confidence in digital repositories and preservation commitments.
representativeEntries: Trusted Digital Repositories | Task Force on Archiving of Digital Information

name: workshop or community of practice
sourceGroundedScope: A convening that develops shared questions, practices, governance, or adoption capacity.
representativeEntries: Workshop on Scholarly Communication as a Commons | EconPort national dissemination workshops

name: library or scholarly association
sourceGroundedScope: A membership organization coordinating standards, advocacy, communities, and shared services.
representativeEntries: American Library Association | Association of Research Libraries | International Association for the Study of Common Property

name: civic-engagement network or campaign
sourceGroundedScope: An organization or network that connects research, teaching, public work, and community problem-solving.
representativeEntries: Campus Compact | Campaign for the Civic Mission of Schools | Center for Democracy and Citizenship

name: glossary, handbook, and annotated-link layer
sourceGroundedScope: Interlinked definitions, explanations, experiments, readings, and external resources within a portal.
representativeEntries: Econterms | Experimental Economics Glossary | EconPort Handbook

name: application programming interface
sourceGroundedScope: A language-independent interface connecting external experiment software to a commons platform.
representativeEntries: EconPort Applications Program Interface
